name: CEDARS' 2026 claims value lists
about: The code lists CEDARS' 2026 claims specification (https://cedars.cpuc.ca.gov/claims/specification/) gives nine Claim and Participant fields that have none here: FundingCycle, BldgLoc, BldgVint, BldgHVAC, DEER_Sector, DEER_MeasureID, MeasImpactCalcType, SEM_Phase and ParticipantType. Each code keeps the years it is in force (CEDARS' start and end dates, by year). The CMPA application IDs and measure codes are not here: those lists change as projects go into the CMPA tool outside CEDARS.
